profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company traded under the ticker STX and headquartered in Singapore, according to its registration details. On its own website the company describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. It describes its storage as scaling, and frames its work as bringing trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site's material is largely oriented toward AI. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, and that people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing large volumes of data. The company says it is optimizing storage for AI and making gains in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout, and it points readers toward assessing their organization's readiness and developing a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth.

Beyond the corporate profile, the facts available on the company are limited: no products, litigation, or MCP servers are recorded.
